note: Owner-curated. Keyed by rule ID. The build fails if a listed rule is no longer 'Known discrepancy', and also if a Known discrepancy rule is missing from this file. `listed: false` keeps a gap off the Redux page (developer notes only).

gaps.summary: How monsters choose targets, flee and use special attacks.
Which shrine a moongate sends you to at midnight.
Where summoned creatures, Blink and Clone land when there is little room.
Who a failed reagent mixture hurts when no one is eligible.
Where the ending text breaks its lines: Redux never makes the original's hyphenated breaks.
A few rare text bytes inside conversations are not represented.
